verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm only daily automatic backups for Pro, Team, and Enterprise projects (supabase-docs-11). That allows recovery to a daily snapshot, not to any point in time. The only reference to point-in-time recovery is a community thread where the CEO mentions moving users to PITR (supabase-comm-4). Branching (supabase-docs-26) is described for testing schema and config changes, not for branching data from a past timestamp. Missing for 10: documented PITR restore to an arbitrary timestamp, a defined retention window, point-in-time branching or cloning of data, and hands-on corroboration of a restore.
